name: Controller initial JS
note: README.md, Performance budgets > Phone controller > Initial JS (gzip).

name: Controller per-game chunk
note: README.md, Performance budgets > Phone controller > Per-game controller chunk (gzip). Checked once per games/*/src/controller entry the controller build actually emits, discovered from the build output, not a maintained list.

name: Controller fonts
note: README.md, Performance budgets > Phone controller > Fonts (2 subsetted WOFF2 files). WOFF2 is already compressed, so this is the raw file size, not gzip.

name: Host platform JS
note: README.md, Performance budgets > Host > Platform JS (gzip, incl. Phaser). Excludes each game's own host/ scene chunk, which is loaded per game, not on platform boot.

name: Host Phaser chunk
note: Not a documented budget on its own (Phaser is folded into the 450 KB host platform JS total). Recorded here as an early-warning ceiling with headroom over the measured ~357.5 KB, so a Phaser version bump shows up as its own failure instead of only tripping the combined platform total. See CC-9.1 implementation notes.
